name: PageScan
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Independent re-review of p0,a1,p50,p100 (960x540 lite). Approved, no blocking issue. Non-blocking: 60 identical cyan tiles give no scale for 12 500; read-head wedge faint at p50; tree nodes small (~28 px at 1080p); tiles reflow between a1 and p50 (left 11 to 10 cols); counter sits on a faint dark plate; light/depth and parity ~6; no motion strip, motion judged from stills and code. See reports/p7/review_dom-b.md.
